title: Runs that find a prompt.md friction each open their own unmergeable control-plane PR; three duplicates of one fix stalled
problem: prompt.md is a CODEOWNERS path, so a PR that edits it waits for the owner. Three process runs on 2026-11-03/04 each found the same friction (step 0 fetches a security-alerts branch that does not exist), each opened its own PR (#12885, #12939, #12975) and ended 'partial', unmerged. The fix has since landed on main by another route (git show origin/main:prompt.md contains "couldn't find remote ref"), so all three prompt.md edits are now redundant and the PRs only carry run records.
evidence: open PR list 2026-11-04: #12885, #12939, #12975 all titled 'process: prompt.md step 0 ... missing security-alerts branch'
mcp get_files on each: each changes only prompt.md plus its own run record; main's prompt.md already has the same edit
run records in those PRs: outcome partial, deviation 'could not merge: CODEOWNERS'
portfolio/ledger/supersede_check.py <pr> did not finish within 4 minutes from a cloud container, so the close was left undone
change: (1) Close #12885, #12939 and #12975 as superseded once supersede_check passes (run it from a session where git fetch is fast; land their run records on main separately if wanted). (2) Add a line to the process prompt: before opening a control-plane PR, search open PRs for the same file and extend that one rather than opening another. (3) Consider a check that lists open PRs touching the same CODEOWNERS path.
metric: open PRs touching prompt.md at once
